lessons.title: Use SLSQP with equality constraints
lessons.summary: Optimization with SLSQP and equality constraints ensures the sum constraint is satisfied.
lessons.lesson: Use the SLSQP optimization method with equality constraints to enforce the sum constraint in the objective function.

lessons.title: Properly define objective and constraint functions
lessons.summary: Ensure the objective function and constraints are correctly defined to avoid runtime errors.
lessons.lesson: Define the objective function to compute the maximum cross-correlation and the constraint function to enforce the sum constraint correctly.

lessons.title: Handle optimization failures gracefully
lessons.summary: Fallback to perturbed guesses or initial solutions if optimization fails.
lessons.lesson: Implement a fallback mechanism to use perturbed guesses or initial solutions if the optimization fails to converge.

lessons.title: Generate diverse initial guesses
lessons.summary: Perturbations and random patterns help find better solutions by exploring different regions of the search space.
lessons.lesson: Perturb the initial guess with small random noise and scale to maintain the sum constraint before optimization.

lessons.title: Fallback to perturbed guesses on failure
lessons.summary: Fallback to perturbed guesses or initial solutions if optimization fails.
lessons.lesson: Implement a fallback mechanism to use perturbed guesses or initial solutions when optimization fails to ensure robustness.

lessons.title: Avoid multiprocessing serialization issues
lessons.summary: Local objects cannot be pickled for multiprocessing, leading to errors.
lessons.lesson: Avoid using local functions in multiprocessing; define helper functions outside the main run function.

lessons.title: Avoid incompatible bounds
lessons.summary: Ensure the number of bounds matches the length of the initial guess to prevent errors.
lessons.lesson: Validate that the number of bounds in the optimization problem matches the length of the initial guess vector to avoid shape mismatches.

lessons.title: Ensure bounds match input size
lessons.summary: Avoid errors by making sure the number of bounds matches the length of the initial guess.
lessons.lesson: Validate that the bounds list has the same length as the initial guess vector to prevent shape mismatch errors.
